about: Diagnostic scrubbing (appendix A 9, 31). scrub(value) returns a copy for stderr: cookie, token and viewer-identifier keys are redacted wherever they appear (JSON keys, form pairs, dict keys), pstatic image URLs lose their signed query, and nothing else changes. Diagnostics never carry snippet source, ARGS or stdout at all. A case with absent instead of output checks only that those values are gone.

cases.fact: The exact redacted form is free; no secret value may survive.
A key's own name counts only as a whole word: pageNo is not idNo.
current-user's naverId is the login id (P2 R18); the blog id stays.
